evidence.observation: O2 rises from ~5 ppm baseline to 13.2 ppm during growth
Monotonic climb to 33.2 ppm over four events while Ar, P, T are at setpoint
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so oxygen ingress is not from a gas-supply change
Pressure steady ~761 Torr, no blockage signature

args.missing_evidence: Whether O2 continues rising (leak) or plateaus/decays (transient outgassing); an Ar flow step test to see if O2 dilutes proportionally would discriminate leak vs outgassing.
